Chili Beans
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 4:55pm

Ingredients




1 pound ground beef (extra lean)
1 medium onion chopped
1 can tomato paste - (6 oz)
1 can onion soup - (10 ½ oz)
1 cup dried red kidney beans or pinto beans
4 cups water
3 tablespoons chili powder
teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon garlic powder
1 teaspoon sugar
teaspoon Tabasco pepper sauce (or a little more if you w

Preparation

1 Brown beef and onion in skillet. Place beef mixture and remaining ingredients in crock pot. Mix well. Cover. Cook on HIGH 8 to 10 hours. 2 This recipe yields 4 to 6 servings.
